implementation.name: sdx-v01
implementation.description: An SDX v0.1 library whose key operations go through the p sdx wallet module; its JOSE implementation is a fork of jose 6.2.13
implementation.source: impl/sdx in the contributor's repository, with impl/sdx-module and impl/ct-admission
implementation.statement: Implements SDX v0.1 (Draft); conformance not demonstrated

driver.transport: JSON lines; one process per session

notes: Keys are held by a p sdx module instance; the driver imports each request's root through the module's host interface. split answers the two root public keys and derive answers no private key (contained keys).

The topic manager decides admission; the driver keeps the admitted outputs per topic, as an overlay engine does for a topic manager. There is no per-topic index, so lookup and the fault hook are not offered.
The secrets and offset hooks and the secp256k1 symmetric key are not offered.
